newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Final telecom spurt helps boost Portugal stocks.
newsitem.headline: Final telecom spurt helps boost Portugal stocks.

text.p: Last minute demand for Portugal Telecom to receive the dividend, optimism over the single currency and the buoyant tone to markets elsewhere all helped the Lisbon bourse close firmer, traders said.
*Telecom accounted for nearly 25 percent of overall business before it goes ex-dividend on Thursday.
*The firmer tone to the escudo as the European Commission issued economic forecasts putting Portugal firmly in line to qualify for monetary union aided the feeling of optimism, traders added.
*PSI-20 index of top blue chips ends 0.81 percent higher at 6,240.33.
Cimpor, like Portugal Telecom, was also lifted by the approach of the dividend even if no date has yet been announced for when the cement group will make the payment.
*Somague recovered from early loss, provoked by uncertainty over the terms of its capital call. Once details were officially released, the stock gained, traders said.
